algebra.checkpointLimit: Serialization was not rerun: main.cu and transfer/layout methods are unchanged, and existing checkpoint payload excludes prefix and denominator scratch.
algebra.definitions: P_i = product_{k<i}(D_k); W_i=E_i*P_i. Forward slot0 copies D0 and E0. Later slots pair(P_i,E_i,D_i), saving W_i and advancing P. Reverse inverse starts at inverse(total product); pair(inv,W_i,D_i) gives lambda_i and next inverse. Slot0 computes lambda0=inv*W0.
algebra.denominatorTags: Forward products use canonical D; jump bits are added only for the existing cache store and masked away before reverse arithmetic.
algebra.zeroConvention: Any D=0 makes the batch product and its defined inverse zero, so all slopes are zero, including live/dead mixtures. This deliberately preserves the existing batch-poisoning behavior.

hostKernelValidation.canaries: Front/back guards on all arrays and report buffers, plus every padded field word in X/Y/D/prefix remain unchanged.
hostKernelValidation.cudaShim: blockDim=256; blockIdx=id/256; threadIdx=id%256; full padded grid plus one extra block; sequential atomicAdd. Physical tiled arrays use ceil(N/256)*256; logical seed/dead/start IDs remain slot*N+tid.

hostKernelValidation.independentReference: Small full rows use ScalarOnb cyclic-convolution normal-basis multiplication and independent Frobenius/index routing, per-slot affine update with original batch-zero convention. It shares the already-bound boundary basis conversions, not packed multiplication/reduction.
hostKernelValidation.nativeInstructionLimit: CLMAD=1 is selected, but ordinary host compilation executes its software fallback. CUDA calling convention, CLMAD hardware, GPU concurrency and device memory behavior are not exercised.
hostKernelValidation.persistentCompared: All normalized X/Y coordinates, seed/start/dead arrays, report and guard counters, stored reports are byte-identical across modes at every recorded stage. Scratch prefix contents differ intentionally.
hostKernelValidation.reportReplayLimit: Seed/replay control flow is separate scalar code but uses existing packed field operations. Independent cyclic-convolution reference separately checks the resulting initialized walk transitions.
hostKernelValidation.weightedPrefixChecks: Exact independent normal-basis weighted product for all B prefix slots on one-step launches; canonical writes on other nonempty launches; slot0 copy and final slot covered at B1/B4/B16/B32.
hostKernelValidation.zeroCoverage: Each slot is independently made zero-D at every batch size, with noncanonical dead value 2 retained. All-zero X/Y with zero DP capacity is also checked. Dead slots still contribute to poisoning.

independentReview.scope: Read-only algebra, tags, dead/DP/guard order, all-prefix writes, mode guards, Make and allocation/checkpoint source review.

ledger.CLMADPairLimit: The unchanged CLMAD pair helper still calls product131 and reduction twice. No native product-count reduction or explicit multiplication-mask reuse is established by the paired call.
ledger.additionalCommonPathLogicalStateBytesPer: 20+40/B; 22.5 at B16, from extra forward Y read and last prefix store/load. Not DRAM bytes or measured cache traffic.
ledger.scope: Observed kernel call boundaries are asserted for every actual host walk launch, including zero steps, zero batches, DP/guard paths and padded invocations. The unrolled inverse body separately contains exactly eight normal mul131 calls.

pairedSigmaValidation.maskTrafficLimit: Instrumented source loads, not native instruction counts, GPU loads, cache misses or memory traffic. Repeated masks may be coalesced by the device compiler.
pairedSigmaValidation.perBranch: All 131 basis bits in each input for each j3..10; 512 dense pairs and six edge pairs per j.

resourceRisks: Forward pass now retains original X, original Y, E and the running product around a paired field call; register lifetime and spill costs are unmeasured.
Paired sigma returns a 40-byte aggregate instead of a 20-byte scalar result and can change register arguments, return moves, scheduling and helper stack use.
Paired product returns still perform two native raw field products. Fewer helper boundaries need not improve a target already using native CLMAD.
Additional common-path Y/prefix logical traffic can outweigh fewer calls or shared source mask loads. Cache/TLB/memory bottlenecks have not been measured.
Source expansion and a new noinline paired-sigma helper can increase instruction-cache footprint.
Host execution does not validate CUDA branch compilation, resource residency, atomic concurrency or throughput.
